prompt: The loop shows every item except the last one.
tells: every item except the last one
why: Stopping one too early is an off-by-one error.
trap: The data is fine; the count is off.

prompt: The table has one extra empty row at the end.
why: Going one too far is off by one.
trap: The extra row isn't from data; the loop overran.

prompt: He used 1 for the first item, but the list starts at 0.
why: Starting at the wrong index is a classic off-by-one.
trap: It's an assumption, but the specific bug is counting.

prompt: Using <= instead of < made the loop read past the end of the array.
why: One comparison sign changes the count by one.
trap: The error may show, but the cause is the count.

prompt: The report for 'the last 7 days' actually covers 8.
why: Including both ends counts one extra.
trap: Data isn't wrong; the range is off by one.

prompt: Page 2 repeats the last item from page 1.
tells: repeats the last item from page 1
why: Overlapping by one item is off by one.
trap: It isn't duplicate data; the boundary is off.
